title: EUROCONTROL Panel Construction: audit code and five-rule protocol
description: Reproducibility package for 'Small-State Aviation Carbon Dynamics: Data Quality, Code Collisions, and Panel Construction in EUROCONTROL Emission Statistics'. Contains the data download script, cleaning routines, the audit code reproducing every table and figure in the paper, and the recommended five-rule panel construction protocol for the EUROCONTROL state-level CO2 emission statistics (2010-2026). Documents and quantifies five construction hazards: two STATE_CODE collisions (LY: Serbia/Montenegro; LS: Switzerland/Liechtenstein), late panel entrants (Latvia 2011, Georgia 2014, Estonia 2018), microstate log-scale leverage (Monaco), persistent estimation flags, and name-encoding traps.
